hypotheses.expect: The plan migration selects only tickets still in flight: a ticket whose cursor stands at a terminal is never opened for write. The terminal set is the class definition's (path ends plus dispositions) united with the grammar's TERMINAL_STATES.
hypotheses.falsifier: (1) a scratch commons with one code-seam ticket each at PROVED, SUPERSEDED, RETIRED, DROPPED, KILLED and ABSORBED plus one at BUILDME selects only the BUILDME ticket, dry and live, and every terminal ticket's files are byte-identical after the live run; (2) a scratch class's own path end is terminal (its ticket is left alone), while a state neither the class nor the grammar calls terminal is selected; (3) a ticket whose class has no definition under the commons refuses the run, naming the class
hypotheses.piece: D1: migrate's selector reads each class's terminal set (path ends plus dispositions) from <root>/node_classes, united with workflow_grammar.TERMINAL_STATES.
